model_annotation: Figure 3(a) presents a line chart comparing the F1 score performance of three different training frameworks—Teacher, Self-Training, and PST—under varying levels of label missing rate on the AAPD dataset. The x-axis, labeled “漏标率” (missing label rate), spans from 0 to 0.585 with linearly spaced tick marks at intervals of 0.1, representing the proportion of missing labels in the dataset. The y-axis, labeled “F1”，ranges from 52.5 to 72.5 with linearly spaced tick marks at intervals of 2.5, indicating the F1 score metric. The red line with square markers, representing the Teacher framework, begins at approximately 71.5 at a missing rate of 0 and declines steadily to about 54.0 at 0.585. The blue line with circular markers, representing Self-Training, starts near 70.5 and decreases to approximately 55.5 at 0.585, showing a slightly less steep decline than Teacher. The green line with triangular markers, representing the PST framework, starts at roughly 71.0 and ends at approximately 57.5, maintaining the highest F1 score across all missing rates and exhibiting the most gradual decline among the three.
